parsed_response.reasoning: The diff shows Salesforce CalendarService now persists `key: { ...accessTokenParsed.data, refresh_token: credentialKey.refresh_token }`. When credential sharing is enabled, `parseRefreshTokenResponse` uses `minimumTokenResponseSchema`, which only guarantees `access_token` (the computed-key zod entries are not meaningful), so the persisted key drops `instance_url`. On subsequent service construction, the jsforce Connection (built from the loaded credential) would receive a stale/undefined instance URL. Also the refreshed token is persisted but the Connection built in the same call uses the pre-refresh `credentialKey`, so the refresh has no effect on the active connection. Mechanism is grounded in the diff; some surrounding lines are context-hidden, so confidence is moderate.
